proposals.value: Explicit wall/floor/ceiling roles in web/src/surfacePalette.ts; category-preserving selected fills; opaque linear-RGB GLB structural materials. F01 has no schema change.
proposals.rationale: Keeps batching and geometry unchanged while removing the ceiling-as-wall fallback and export color mismatch.

proposals.value: Opposite-corner wall-chart resize; edge u-only translation; explicit threshold; optional style/end/side capabilities; full reversal and bent-host policy.
proposals.rationale: Reuses full-arclength helpers without fabricating legacy door subtype or bending rigid leaves.

proposals.value: Freeze uniform legacy planes as inferred ceiling intent, unequal tops as null; explicit room height; extend necessary wall spans without shrinking them; preserve neighbor ceilings; explicit structure set/common delta.
proposals.rationale: Avoids neighbor ceiling changes from a shared wall and preserves captured height differences until an explicit correction.

proposals.value: Versioned parametric dimensions and explicit floor/wall mount; white faces/blue edges; diagrammatic nonblocking fixtures initially.
proposals.rationale: No competing editor, fake image dimensions or unimplemented obstacle-avoidance claim.

proposals.value: Independent moisture/fire records, explicit wall vertical range, physical footprint and recorded support mask; no new totals.
proposals.rationale: Prevents new damage appearing when a hole is filled, a host expands or a ceiling moves.

proposals.value: Role-qualified floor/room/ceiling references; wall ID plus positive/negative side; meters along wall and above base; fixed floor X/Z chart.
proposals.rationale: Scene triangle numbers, camera directions and undifferentiated room IDs are not durable attachment identities.

proposals.value: Snapshot/context/revision fence; frame-coalesced preview; exact final sample; one command/undo item; pre-submit cancel saves nothing; existing pending-save semantics after submit.
proposals.rationale: The current workspace commit signature needs an explicit drag-start revision fence; it cannot be assumed to supply one.

proposals.value: Compose source/result surface transforms and exact source domains; retain clipped/unresolved observations, reject unresolved rigid-fixture moves.
proposals.rationale: Existing ID mappings mark review but do not preserve physical attachment coordinates.

proposals.value: Strict feature-local versions, proposed geometry 1.2/1.3/1.4/1.5 in task order; coordinated scene/profile changes only when vocabulary changes; no writable lossy downgrade.
proposals.rationale: Old schemas reject unknown fields, and current imports regenerate/compare scene geometry.

proposals.value: One shared workspace; exact host transfer/readback, actual Capacitor assets and Apple evidence, staged OS generation with separate authority; no assumed deployment.
proposals.rationale: Current source, served web and installed app have distinct revisions and acceptance gates.

proposals.value: Optional Opening.style is {id,end?,side?,provenance}; style IDs are the seven verified presets, kind and required orientation capabilities are validated. Legacy style remains absent. Style/flip-only commands author nested style provenance and preserve base aperture provenance. Only actual geometry correction follows the existing aperture provenance transition. Cosmetic style must not unlock inferred portals.
proposals.rationale: Bounded read-only source review identified concrete F02 consumers and backward-compatibility risks.

proposals.value: Reserve geometry 1.2.0 and scene 1.2.0 after collision check. Add explicit opening face role owned by opening ID. Keep immutable old schemas. Retain local-document 1.0/1.1 and drawing profiles while member/vocabulary contracts stay unchanged; complete geometry/scene remain separately versioned. Reject 1.2 from constrained legacy v1 exchange/outbox with an actionable complete-local-document alternative. Styled drawing recovery uses formatVersion 2 alongside legacy 1. No database version migration solely for this payload.
proposals.rationale: Bounded read-only source review identified concrete F02 consumers and backward-compatibility risks.

proposals.value: setArea and scene area branches must never downgrade a higher admitted version. Room/wall/placement preflights preserve the source document version instead of synthesizing only 1.0/1.1. Drawings/export extents include style symbols. New opening emitters explicitly dispatch material roles without changing accepted structural palette.
proposals.rationale: Bounded read-only source review identified concrete F02 consumers and backward-compatibility risks.

proposals.value: F02-F05 may implement concurrently on their exact isolated branches. The master alone integrates F02, then F03, F04 and F05. Dependency-sensitive code is verified against real accepted predecessors before combined acceptance. See PARALLEL_DEVELOPMENT.md.

SURFACE_INTERFACE.md revision 1 fixes SurfaceRef, physical domains, transforms, resolver entry points, additive remap receipts and minimal fixture mounts. F03 owns first core/surfaces.ts implementation; F04/F05 consume the same vocabulary. No duplicate surface frameworks or inferred successful integration.

Reserve geometry/scene 1.2.0 for F02, 1.3.0 for F03, 1.4.0 for F04 and 1.5.0 for F05. These names are unoccupied in the inspected maintained source. Later schemas must incorporate accepted predecessor fields/roles/admission. Preserve old files and source snapshots; feature branches cannot overwrite newer schema consumers.

If a uniform legacy wall-top plane cannot represent positive floor-relative clearance, migrate its ceiling intent to null while preserving the original snapshot. Do not invent a positive height or reject otherwise valid legacy input solely to infer a ceiling. New rooms in the ceiling schema have explicit established/null state.

proposals.topic: Optional host cutouts and service penetrations
proposals.value: Owner approved optional floor/ceiling cutouts and penetrations, extending wall cutouts. CUTOUT_SCOPE.md fixes explicit host selection, rectangle/circle profiles, real subtraction, strict cumulative admission, exact attachments, floor walk-support checks and retained observation support. No recess depth, automatic shafts or portal permissions.
proposals.owner_instruction: We can implement cutouts to ceilings/floors and penetrations if possible just as an option to the user.

open.question: Which bounded variants of appliances and built-ins beyond the named families belong in the first catalog?
open.recommendation: Master records a proposed checklist at F04; all named families remain required. Do not treat etc. as an exhaustive source inventory.

accepted_by: Spatial master, owner-approved GitHub recording and parallel workflow
acceptance_scope: D01-D17 engineering contract accepted; implementation and platform gates remain independent. Q01/Q02 remain open for F04 only.

resolved.question: Wall through-openings only, or also recesses, boundary notches and floor/ceiling voids?
resolved.recommendation: Start with true wall cutouts; retain other interpretations as open until explicitly resolved.
resolved.owner_instruction: We can implement cutouts to ceilings/floors and penetrations if possible just as an option to the user.
resolved.resolution: Optional wall/floor/ceiling through-cutouts and service penetrations. Recesses, notches and automatic multi-level shafts are outside this first scope.
